fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: Duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: IsCaughtUp
fields.about: True if the broker has approximately caught up with the latest metadata.

fields.name: IsFenced
fields.about: True if the broker is fenced.

fields.name: ShouldShutDown
fields.about: True if the broker should proceed with its shutdown.
